segs: It is stated in Sefer Yetzirah,
according to the version of the Arizal:
"He crowned the letter zayin in walking," etc.,
"and the left foot in the soul."
the time of the receiving of the Torah,
"Fortunate are those whose way is perfect,
who walk in the Torah of Hashem,"
But what connection does the left foot have
to the matter of receiving the Torah?
However, one can say regarding this,
along the lines of the saying of Chazal
"and it stands to reason that the good one is at his right," etc.,
'The heart of a wise man is at his right,
and the heart of a fool at his left.'"
That is, the counsel for external matters,
for the needs of the body,
And it is stated in the Midrash (Vayikra Rabbah 35:1)
and turned my feet back to Your testimonies":
'I am going to such-and-such a place,'
and my feet would bring me
to batei knessiyos and batei midrashos."
had the words of Torah become fixed in his heart
which are of the aspect of the left foot,
there came from this itself a right,
"'I did not toil, yet I found' — do not believe it,"
of the contradiction within the expression "I toiled and I found":
רַק שֶׁעַל יְדֵי הַיְגִיעָה הַרְבֵּה מִקּוֹדֶם
only that through much toil beforehand
by way of a find, unexpectedly.
And to this one can apply the expression
So what is the expression "and I turned back,"
from which it appears that he turned them back?
so that they would now turn back by themselves
And to this the left foot alludes:
even the walking of the left
is likewise turned to the right,
And the version of the Geonim:
"He crowned the letter zayin in smell," etc.,
the allusion to acquiring words of Torah,
comes through purity of the soul
from the impurity that issues from the body,
"Purity nullified the taste and the smell," etc.;
"I smell the scent of a chinunisa" —
אָמַר לוֹ: בְּנִי, טָהֳרָה יֵשׁ בְּךָ.
he said to him, "My son, there is purity in you."
And certainly what is meant is not merely
purity from the tumah of the body,
for at that time there was no longer in effect
וְגַם לֹא הָיָה לָהֶם אֵפֶר פָּרָה
nor did they have the ashes of the parah
It is also stated in the Gemara (Eruvin 21b)
these are the young men of Yisrael
who have not tasted the taste of sin.
at the time of childhood and youth,
שֶׁאָז הַיֵּצֶר הָרַע שֶׁל תַּאֲוָה מִתְגַּבֵּר.
when the yetzer hara of desire grows strong.
And then, when one guards himself in this
he is the vessel prepared for receiving the Torah,
which is acquired in the soul through yiras Shamayim,
"The beginning of wisdom is the fear of Hashem."
And this is the aspect of smell,
"And He will imbue him with a sense of the fear of Hashem,"
this is one who learns Torah in purity," etc.
well known is the saying of Chazal (Berachos 61b),
yet in the Zohar HaKadosh it is evident
that from the spleen sadness is born in a person,
"the sadness of the spleen and the anger of the gall."
for one is set against the other:
regarding the laughter of the fool,
that is, the joy of frivolity,
from it are born sadness and melancholy,
that it brings wailing and sadness in the end.
And this is the root of the serpent's enticement
that it brought sorrow into the heart of man,
"In sorrow you shall eat of it," etc.;
it brings laxity into the heart
toward the pursuit of avodas Hashem.
However, the laughter and the joy
through "the fear of Hashem is pure"
one comes to "the precepts of Hashem are upright,
as in "my joy is from within my fear"
And the matter of the letter zayin
יֵשׁ לוֹ גַּם כֵּן שַׁיָּיכוּת לְמַתַּן תּוֹרָה,
also has a connection to Matan Torah,
as stated in the Midrash (Shemos Rabbah 30:3):
with weapons on this side and weapons on that side
so too the Torah — judgments on this side," etc.
For the Torah comes from the side of Gevurah
and from the side of Yitzchak
דְּכֵן הוּא נִקְרָא עַל שֵׁם הַצְּחוֹק,
for indeed he is named for laughter,
and as it says in the Midrash
that there was much laughter in the world,
וְכֵן בְּמִדְרָשׁ הַנֶּעְלָם [חֵלֶק א קכט, א]] —
and so too in the Midrash HaNe'lam (Zohar I, 129a) —
Only through the power of the Torah
as stated in the Zohar HaKadosh
"and He shone forth from Seir to them":
that we were given the power of the sword
"and Who is the sword of your majesty."
And specifically to subdue his own side,
"Their sword shall enter their own heart," etc.
And this is as it says (ibid. 149:6),
"and a double-edged sword in their hand,
to execute vengeance upon the nations," etc.
And this is "the weapons on this side and on that side,"
like the shape of the letter zayin
And this is the connection of the letter zayin as well
the time of the receiving of the Torah.
"On this day they came to the wilderness of Sinai"
That words of Torah should be new to you
as if they were given today."
הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה ה׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ מְצַוְּךָ וְגוֹמֵר.
'This day Hashem your God commands you,'" etc.
וְכֵן דָּרְשׁוּ עַל פָּסוּק [שָׁם כז, ט]
Similarly they expounded on the pasuk (ibid. 27:9),
"This day you have become a people":
to teach you that the Torah is as beloved to those who learn it
as on the day it was given from Har Sinai
And likewise "which I command you this day"
in the parshiyos of Krias Shema
Now, in all of these this derashah fits:
since the Torah had already been given,
so that words of Torah be new to you
as if they were given today.
on the day they came to the wilderness of Sinai,
when they had not yet been given
any words of Torah on that day,
what bearing does it have here,
that they should be as if given today?
And from the language of the Pesikta it appears
"This day Hashem your God commands you."
"The Torah was given to His children
and the Torah is in the secret of Twins" —
Torah she'bichsav and Torah she'b'al peh.
הָא בְּמִדְרָשׁ (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה מו, א) אִיתָא:
why, in the Midrash (Shemos Rabbah 46:1) it is stated:
"Do not be distressed over the first Luchos,
שֶׁלֹּא הָיוּ אֶלָּא עֲשֶׂרֶת הַדִּבְּרוֹת בִּלְבַד,
which held only the Aseres HaDibros;
in the second Luchos I am giving you
that there will be in them
It emerges that Torah she'b'al peh
was given only with the second Luchos,
which were given on Yom Kippur.
And so we find also in the Gemara
only the five Chumashim of the Torah," etc.,
'For in much wisdom is much anger.'"
All the more so Torah she'b'al peh,
which was not needed before the downfall,
just as it will be in the future,
וְלֹא יְלַמְּדוּ עוֹד אִישׁ אֶת רֵעֵהוּ וְגוֹמֵר
"And they will no longer teach each man his fellow," etc.,
"for they will all know Me," etc.
that the first Dibros were given
expounds on "In the third month" (Shemos ibid.):
a renewal in the heart of Yisrael.
And the matter is based on what I heard
from our holy Rebbe of Izhbitz, zt"l,
regarding what is said in the Midrash
in the story of the peddler:
כָּל יָמַי הָיִיתִי קוֹרֵא הַפָּסוּק הַזֶּה
"All my days I would read this pasuk
until this peddler came and made known to him:
"Who is the man who desires life?"
Seemingly, what did he learn from the peddler,
who told him only the pasuk as it stands
that in all words of Torah
meaning that one senses taste and sweetness
וְהָרוֹכֵל הַזֶּה שֶׁהָיָה לוֹ עֵסֶק בָּזֶה,
And this peddler had dealings with this matter,
for he had been corrupted in the matter of rechilus,
from the expression "goes about as a talebearer";
and after his teshuvah for this,
when he came to grasp this word of Torah,
he sensed a new taste in this pasuk.
And this is what Rabbi Yannai learned from him,
שֶׁזֶּה הַטַּעַם לֹא הָיָה יָכוֹל לְהַרְגִּישׁ
for this taste could be sensed
רַק מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ לוֹ עֵסֶק בָּזֶה.
only by one who had dealings in this.
"but a foolish man swallows it up":
in which a person is foolish
words of Torah are absorbed in his heart
and he senses a different taste.
And this is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh
that is within the pesukim of Torah she'bichsav.
is the aspect of the light of the sun,
is the moon that receives from the sun.
Now, the nations of the world count by the sun
"The great one counts by the great one,
and the small one counts by the small one."
"Therefore the Holy One, Blessed is He, transmitted
the secret of the moon to Yisrael,
that they should count by it," etc.,
"and just as the moon is of light,
so Yisrael inherit the light," etc.
For the nations of the world count by the sun,
which is fire, and fire shall consume them;
which in itself is not fire
but only receives the light from the sun.
וְהַיְינוּ כִּי שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן ה׳ אֱלֹהִים,
And this is "For a sun and a shield is Hashem Elokim,"
"For Hashem your God is a consuming fire";
and "the Holy One, Blessed is He, is called Torah,"
וְאֵין תּוֹרָה אֶלָּא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא,
and "the Torah is none other than the Holy One, Blessed is He,"
as stated in the Zohar HaKadosh
וְהוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאִיתָא בְּמִדְרָשׁ רַבָּה
And this is based on what is stated in Midrash Rabbah
"The Holy One, Blessed is He, is not so;
and He fulfills it first," etc.
הֵם דְּרָכָיו שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא,
are the ways of the Holy One, Blessed is He,
"and you shall walk in His ways,"
As we find explicitly regarding the mitzvah of Shabbos:
"and He rested on the seventh day;
עַל כֵּן בֵּרַךְ וְגוֹמֵר [שְׁמוֹת כ, יא],
And so it is in the Midrash (Tanchuma Bereishis 2):
כִּי הֵיכִי דְּנָחֵי בֵּיהּ אֲנָא וְכוּלֵּי.
just as I rested on it," etc.
וְזֶהוּ וְאֵין תּוֹרָה אֶלָּא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא,
And this is "the Torah is none other than the Holy One, Blessed is He":
הוּא רַק עַל יְדֵי וְהָלַכְתָּ בִּדְרָכָיו,
is only through "and you shall walk in His ways,"
and this is called sun and fire.
is the renewal in words of Torah,
and this is "the moon that receives from the sun";
it is the light and the taste in words of Torah,
the taste and sweetness one senses in the heart.
לֹא מָצִינוּ שׁוּם קְדוּשָּׁה לְרֹאשׁ חוֹדֶשׁ,
we find no sanctity for Rosh Chodesh;
"The head of the beis din says, 'Mekudash,'"
when filled from what is holy, becomes sanctified,
who are holy and sanctify the month."
And at the time of Matan Torah,
the learning of Torah was implanted in their heart
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה א, ב),
וְאָז כְּבָר הָיָה דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה נִבְלַע בְּלִבָּם,
and then words of Torah were already absorbed in their heart,
and they all sensed the tastes of Torah,
and then it was as it will be in the future:
"And they will no longer teach," etc.,
and they all had Torah she'b'al peh —
which is "a sun and a shield is Hashem Elokim."
And this is what the Zohar HaKadosh says:
that for this reason the Torah was given
"and the Torah is in the secret of Twins" —
Torah she'bichsav and Torah she'b'al peh.
And here it is expounded that "ba'chodesh" is written,
which they expounded as "something new came":
that then a renewal came into the heart of Yisrael.
And what was the renewal that came then,
since the Torah had not yet been given?
Rather, it is the desire and the longing
that every one of Yisrael had
when they came to the wilderness of Sinai,
the place where they would receive the Torah.
And this is based on what is said
that he said to that student
"I am engaged in words of Torah,
and I yearn, desire and wait:
"A man does not merit words of Torah
אֶלָּא אִם כֵּן מוֹסֵר נַפְשׁוֹ עָלֶיהָ וְכוּלֵּי,
unless he gives over his soul for it," etc.,
'The poor and the needy seek water
and there is none; their tongue fails for thirst;
I, Hashem, will answer them,' etc."
וְהַיְינוּ שֶׁאֵין הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא נוֹתֵן
That is, the Holy One, Blessed is He, gives
דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה רַק לְמִי שֶׁצָּמֵא לָהֶם,
words of Torah only to one who thirsts for them,
and then "I, Hashem, will answer them."
that he said to that man
who said that he had not been given
ה׳ אֱלֹהִים נָתַן לִי לְשׁוֹן לִמּוּדִים
"Hashem Elokim has given me a learned tongue,
to know how to sustain the weary," etc.:
שֶׁאֵין דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה נִבְלָעִים בְּלֵב הָאָדָם
that words of Torah are absorbed in a person's heart
אֶלָּא בְּמִי שֶׁהוּא יָעֵף לָהֶם וְכוּלֵּי.
only in one who is faint with longing for them," etc.
"For I will pour water upon the thirsty":
שֶׁאֵין ה׳ יִתְבָּרַךְ נוֹתֵן דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה
Hashem Yisbarach gives words of Torah
only to one who thirsts for them,
for "cool water upon a weary soul."
And in such a person words of Torah are absorbed,
"but a foolish man swallows it up."
And the main thing for words of Torah
to be absorbed in the heart,
so that one senses the tastes of Torah,
is the desire and the thirst
that a person has for words of Torah.
Therefore it is written "on this day";
as one points with a finger.
And here it is not stated explicitly
that the day was Rosh Chodesh;
from the verse "This chodesh shall be for you"
that it was on Rosh Chodesh.
that they had the desire and the will,
and then the renewal came to them,
so that through this they would sense
in the words of Torah they would receive.
And this is why "on this day" is expounded:
"that words of Torah should be new to you
as if they were given today" —
that Yisrael should always have this desire,
on which they came to the wilderness of Sinai,
when they had the wondrous desire,
expounded as "something new came," as above.
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכוּ אַחַר כָּךְ
And through this they later merited
the renewal of Torah she'b'al peh,
they sense in words of Torah
when the words of Torah are absorbed.
even after the Torah was given,
one must feel in the heart
a renewed desire to receive words of Torah,
words of Torah will be absorbed in the heart
and one will sense the tastes of Torah.
Now, in Sefer Yetzirah it is stated
that the month of Sivan was created with the letter zayin;
and concerning the letter zayin, the Zohar HaKadosh states
This is 'a sword of Hashem, filled with blood'"
corresponds to the attribute of Malchus.
And the end of the pasuk is:
"For Hashem has a sacrifice in Botzrah
and a great slaughter in the land of Edom";
and this accords with what it says
to judge the mountain of Esav,
and the kingdom shall be Hashem's."
And this accords with what they expounded
וְנָשָׂא הַשָּׂעִיר עָלָיו אֶת כָּל עֲוֹנוֹתָם —
"'And the goat shall carry upon itself all their iniquities' —
in the heart of Yisrael as well.
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאִיתָא בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
And this accords with what is stated in the Zohar HaKadosh
on "and He shone forth from Seir to them" (Devarim 33:2):
"He stripped from him the light that covered him
and gave it to be given to Yisrael;
'and He shone forth from Seir to them.'"
And what was the light that Samael and Esav had?
אַךְ הוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ
But it is according to what they said
there is wisdom in Edom — believe it,
'And I will destroy the wise men from Edom';
there is Torah — do not believe it,
'Among the nations there is no Torah.'"
That is, Edom and Esav had wisdom,
עַד שֶׁהָיָה יָכוֹל לְרַמּוֹת אֶת יִצְחָק:
so much that he could deceive Yitzchak:
לֹא כָּךְ הוּא הֲלָכָה מִן כָּךְ וְכָךְ,
"Is not the halachah such-and-such regarding this,
לֹא כָּךְ אִיסּוּרוֹ, לֹא כָּךְ הֶיתֵּרוֹ
is not this its prohibition, is not this its permission?"
that would instruct him toward the heart —
His chief wisdom was in the sword,
to conquer the whole world under his hand;
and this Yisrael received from him for holiness,
and it is Torah she'b'al peh —
"a sword of Hashem, filled with blood" —
and I created Torah as its antidote" —
וְהַיְינוּ עַל יְדֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה,
that is, through Torah she'b'al peh,
drag him to the beis midrash" —
which is the place where halachah is innovated,
from the term for sword and weapons,
שֶׁהוּא כְּלֵי זַיִין נֶגֶד הַיֵּצֶר הָרָע.
for it is a weapon against the yetzer hara.
And Shabbos, which corresponds to the attribute of Malchus —
we call it Torah she'b'al peh"
and it is stated in the Zohar HaKadosh
the dross of the attribute of Chessed,
desires, cravings and love of this world.

the attribute of Chessed and desire,
to become a craving for Torah,
as it will be in the future,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א קלח, א).
who was the dross of the attribute of Gevurah
and put all his wisdom into the sword

the sword of Hashem filled with blood,

תּוֹרָה שֶׁבִּכְתָב וְתוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה כַּנַּ״ל,
Torah she'bichsav and Torah she'b'al peh, as above —
was created with the letter zayin,

for words of Torah to be absorbed in the heart

even though the Torah has already been given,

"and sweeter than honey and the drippings of the honeycomb":
